_doc: Known places where the nav map's solid space and the game disagree, or agree, for checking the hidden collider audit and the bake. box: x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1 in game space (not car-inflated). truth: what is there in game. rays: segments through the box; expect: what the game's collision answers (clear: nothing to hit; hit: real collision). Checked offline with tools/world/collision_at.py --case <name> and in game with tools/ingame/check_collider.py --case <name>.

cases.name: highway_pillar_ghost
cases.truth: nothing: open air beside the elevated road, Jack saw nothing there (North run, 2026-10-30, the swerve at 0:21)
cases.navmap: blocked from z 22 to 210 in bake_2026-10-29_noblockers; free from z 34 to 118 since bake_2026-10-30_forced (no hollow fill)
cases.cause: bake: spans.py fill_hollow filled the 32 to 120 m gap under the wall of an overhead mass (exterior_-5_-3_0_2 World Static, z 120 to 208) as if it were a 15 m thick roof; only a corner of one mesh reaches into the box (exterior_-3_-2_0_3 node 466 group 22 actor 24, z 85 to 97). In game, rays at z 50 and 70 are clear.

cases.name: highway_wall_west
cases.truth: the wall left of the 15 m gap the North route takes under the elevated road (real collision)
cases.cause: real collision: exterior_-10_-6_0_1 Complex / Simple Environment Collision, exterior_-19_-12_0_0 World Static
cases.note: 2026-10-30 in game: LtbfBridge.Ray came back clear here (expected hit). Its preset is Complex Environment Collision, likely outside the ray's query groups (Static, Terrain, VehicleBlocker, PlayerBlocker): to check before trusting a clear ray on such collision.
